import hashlib, json, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from factoryline.team_pilot import evaluate_team_pilot_readiness
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
    root = Path(raw)
    (root / 'docs').mkdir()
    (root / 'docs' / 'COMMERCIAL_PACKAGING.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 'factory.commercial-packaging.v1', 'governance': {'classification': 'human_controlled', 'automation_may_activate': False}, 'current_verdict': 'COMMERCIALIZATION_STAGED_NOT_SELLABLE', 'tiers': {'team_proof_hub': {'availability': 'design_partner_only', 'purchasable': False}}}), encoding='utf-8')
    kinds = ['commercial_terms_review', 'data_retention_decision', 'deployment_security_review', 'design_partner_selection', 'support_and_incident_owner']
    evidence = []
    for kind in kinds:
        path = root / f'{kind}.json'
        path.write_text(json.dumps({'kind': kind}), encoding='utf-8')
        evidence.append({'kind': kind, 'path': path.name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    manifest = {'schema': 'factory.team-pilot-launch.v1', 'pilot_id': 'smoke-team', 'owner': 'smoke-owner', 'partner_count': 3, 'governance': 'human_controlled', 'delivery_mode': 'customer_managed_reference', 'evidence': evidence}
    path = root / 'team-pilot.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding='utf-8')
    receipt = evaluate_team_pilot_readiness(root, path)
    assert receipt['marker'] == 'TEAM_PILOT_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW'
    assert receipt['authority']['payment'] is False
print('TEAM_PILOT_READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW')
